description: This file defines a mock class 'ClientControllerMock' for the 'IClientController' interface, used for unit testing within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. It includes mock methods for managing shared memory handles and client registration.

classes.name: ClientControllerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IClientController interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an ISharedMemoryHandle, mocked for testing.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client with the controller, taking a pointer to IControlClient and an ApplicationState reference.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client from the controller.
